text.en:
Amendments. (a) Section 3 of EO No. 79 is hereby amended to
read as follows:
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

"Section 3. Composition. The ICCMN shall be composed
of one (1) representative each from the Office of the Presidential
Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (OPAPRU) and the
Office of the President, with a rank not lower than an
Undersecretary, as Co-Chairpersons. The members shall consist of
representatives from the following agencies with ranks not lower
than an Assistant Secretary or its equivalent:
(b) The succeeding sections of EO No. 79, which make express reference to
the OPAPP and OCS, are hereby amended accordingly.

Unaffected Provisions. Except as expressly modified by this
Order, all other provisions of EO No. 79 shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All orders, rules, regulations and issuances or parts thereof,
which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 5th
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Two.
day of October
By the President:
LUCAS P. BERSAMIN
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
